description: Add a Google-Destinations-style bottom selected-place bar to the right map (like https://mapsplatform.google.com/demos/destinations/), showing the selected destination's NAME and location/type with a chevron affordance, inset from the bottom corners so Google's logo/legal attribution stays visible. Wire it to the existing selected-place state so searching+selecting a place updates the bar + marker + recenter. Implement a hybrid resolve: use Google SearchDestinations for navigable destinations (building/POI/address) WHEN the API is actually available in the loaded Maps JS build (feature-detected via importLibrary), progressively enhancing with building outline / entrances when geometry is returned; fall back to the EXISTING Places/geocoding flow for cities/towns/areas (and whenever SearchDestinations is unavailable or returns nothing), with NO fabricated outline. Explicitly: do NOT add any 'Use my location' / browser-GPS control. Coexists with the real AQI/PM2.5 deck.gl dot layer and the no-double-fetch rule (the bar must NOT trigger air/weather/pollen fetches). Depends on FEAT-002/FEAT-003.
steps: Read the map-stage markup in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx (~line 2114 `.vl-live-map-stage`), which already contains the centered search (.vl-live-map-search ~2142) and the top-right AQI/PM2.5 controls (.vl-live-map-controls ~2215). Add a NEW bottom bar element INLINE inside `.vl-live-map-stage`, gated on `liveActive` (and render only when a place name exists). Keep ALL JSX inline so styled-jsx keeps its vl-live- scope - do not lift into a variable/child.

BOTTOM BAR MARKUP: a .vl-live-map-destbar element positioned absolute, inset from the bottom and horizontally sized like the demo (centered, max-width, inset so it does NOT overlap the bottom-corner Google logo/.gm-style-cc legal - keep it clear of the corners, e.g. left/right inset + bottom offset above the attribution strip). Content: the destination NAME (uppercase like the demo, from place.name/previewPlace.name) + a middle-dot separator + a secondary line/segment that is the location-or-type (prefer previewPlace.primaryType when present, else the formatted address previewPlace.addr), and a trailing chevron ('›') affordance. Make it a real control (button) that is keyboard-focusable; clicking it may recenter the map on the destination (map.setCenter + marker) - do NOT make it fetch air/weather/pollen. aria-label should read like '<name>, <location/type>'. Never fabricate a type/location - show only what is actually in state (name + addr are always present; primaryType only when Google returned it).

STYLE .vl-live-map-destbar in the styled-jsx block using the design system: white (or near-white #fafafa) surface, dark-green #1a3a2a text, rounded (reference-card geometry, e.g. ~14px or pill), NO heavy resting shadow (a very subtle elevation is acceptable since it floats over the map, but keep it light), exact lime #d1f470 only if an accent is needed (e.g. the chevron or a hairline). The name uppercase/bold, the secondary segment muted. Must remain readable over the roadmap. Keep z-index below the search dropdown but above the canvas. Ensure it is inset from the bottom-left corner where Google paints its logo and from the bottom-right .gm-style-cc legal - verify by insetting enough margin; add a comment noting the attribution clearance. Do NOT add any CSS targeting .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google].

HYBRID RESOLVE - SearchDestinations when available, else Places/geocoding. The component already resolves a selected place via the modern Places Autocomplete + Place.fetchFields path (choose()) and via reverse-geocode on map click. Add a feature-detected SearchDestinations enhancement: attempt `await google.maps.importLibrary('search')` (or whatever the SearchDestinations library/namespace is in the loaded build) and feature-detect the SearchDestinations / displayPolygon capability; if present AND the selection looks like a navigable destination (building/POI/address - e.g. the Place has a primaryType / is not a locality/administrative area), resolve the destination through it and, when geometry (building outline polygon / entrances / navigation points) is returned, progressively render it on the map (e.g. a google.maps.Polygon outline and/or small entrance markers) using the no-red palette (dark-green/lime strokes, translucent lime fill at low opacity so roads stay visible). If SearchDestinations is unavailable in the loaded Maps JS build (very likely in the referrer-restricted/sandbox context and possibly in prod), DEGRADE SILENTLY to the existing Places/geocoding flow with just the marker + bottom bar name - NO fake outline, NO error surfaced to the user. For cities/towns/areas (localities / administrative areas, which Google documents as NOT valid SearchDestinations searches), always use the existing Places/geocoding path and show only the bottom-bar name + marker (no building outline).

Guard the whole feature behind MAPS_KEY (honest degradation: no key => no map, no bar, no SearchDestinations import, zero network). Ensure the bottom bar + any SearchDestinations/polygon work does NOT fire air/weather/pollen/currentConditions fetches - those remain gated strictly on the AQI/PM2.5 pill (FEAT-002). The SearchDestinations resolve may issue its own destination lookup request (that is the destination-resolution call, acceptable and distinct from the environmental-layer fetches), but it must be triggered by SELECTION only, not by typing, and must be abortable/cleaned up.

Clean up any building-outline/entrance overlays when the place changes or on unmount (remove polygon/markers from the map; abort in-flight destination lookups) so stale geometry never lingers over a new place.

TESTS in src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx (behavioral, not snapshot-brittle): (a) after selecting a place, the bottom destination bar renders with the selected place's NAME and its location/type (assert the .vl-live-map-destbar text contains the resolved place name). (b) The bar renders NO fabricated type/outline when Google returns none - with the default stub (no primaryType, SearchDestinations absent), the bar shows name + address only and no building polygon is drawn. (c) Selecting a place / showing the bar fires ZERO air/weather/pollen fetches (reuse the FEAT-002 no-fetch-on-select assertion pattern). (d) There is NO 'Use my location' / geolocation control in the DOM (assert no button/text matching /use my location|my location|current location/i and that navigator.geolocation is never called - the component must not reference it). (e) Honest degradation: with no key, no bottom bar is rendered. If SearchDestinations cannot be meaningfully stubbed, assert the DEGRADED path (bar + name + marker, no outline) which is the path that actually runs in sandbox, and document that the SearchDestinations-available branch is only verifiable on a live *.wecare.digital origin.
Confirm no 'Use my location' / navigator.geolocation usage exists anywhere in VayuLokLive (the user explicitly dropped that idea).
acceptance_criteria: A bottom selected-place bar (.vl-live-map-destbar) renders inside the map stage when live, showing the selected destination NAME + location/type (primaryType when available, else address) + a chevron affordance, styled in the home design system (white/#fafafa + #1a3a2a + lime accent, no heavy resting shadow).
The bar is inset so it does not overlap Google's bottom-corner logo or .gm-style-cc legal attribution; no CSS targets .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google].
Searching + selecting a place updates the bar, marker, and recenter via existing state; the bar does NOT trigger air/weather/pollen fetches.

Hybrid resolve: SearchDestinations is used ONLY when feature-detected as available and the selection is a navigable destination, progressively drawing building outline/entrances (no-red palette) when geometry is returned; otherwise the existing Places/geocoding path runs with marker + bar name only and NO fabricated outline. Cities/areas always use Places/geocoding.
No 'Use my location' / browser-geolocation control exists; navigator.geolocation is never referenced.
Honest degradation: no key => no map, no bar, no SearchDestinations import, zero fetches.
The real AQI/PM2.5 deck.gl dot layer (FEAT-002) and the pill restyle (FEAT-003) are unchanged and still pass their tests.
VayuLokLive test suite is green including new bottom-bar + no-geolocation assertions.

findings: Implemented in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx + src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx on branch vayulok-finish-unmerged. (1) Added an inline .vl-live-map-destbar <button> inside .vl-live-map-stage, gated on `liveActive && previewPlace.name`. It shows the uppercase NAME + middle-dot + (previewPlace.primaryType || previewPlace.addr) + a '\u203a' chevron; aria-label is '<name>, <loc/type>'. Clicking it recenters the map (setCenter+zoom 16 + marker.setPosition) and fires NO air/weather/pollen. CSS insets it (bottom:36px, max-width min(420px,calc(100% - 96px)), centered) so Google's bottom-left logo and bottom-right .gm-style-cc legal stay visible; white surface, #1a3a2a text, 14px radius, light elevation, lime #d1f470 only on the chevron. No CSS targets .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google]. (2) Added a feature-detected hybrid-resolve effect keyed on [place, mapReady]: it first clears any prior outline polygon/entrance markers and aborts any in-flight destination lookup (so geometry never lingers / leaks on unmount), skips SearchDestinations for area-like places (no primaryType, or primaryType matching locality/administrative/political/etc.), and for navigable destinations tries `importLibrary('search')` + checks for a SearchDestinations.searchDestinations capability. When present it resolves the destination (abortable via AbortController) and draws displayPolygon as a google.maps.Polygon (stroke #1a3a2a, fill #d1f470 @ 0.18 opacity -> no red, roads stay visible) + entrances as small lime circle markers. SearchDestinations is ABSENT in the sandbox stub and the referrer-restricted build, so the component degrades silently to marker + bottom-bar name with NO fabricated outline and NO user-facing error. (3) No 'use my location'/navigator.geolocation anywhere (grep clean except prose comments). (4) FEAT-002 deck.gl dots + FEAT-003 pills/focus-ring untouched. VERIFICATION (sandbox, live Google cannot run as expected): `npm run typecheck` PASS (0 errors); `npm run lint` PASS (0 errors, 203 pre-existing warnings, none in the FEAT-004 additions - the 3 VayuLokLive warnings at lines 612/622/873 predate this change); `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` PASS 32/32 (28 prior + 4 new FEAT-004 behavioral tests: bar renders name+address & draws no polygon on degraded path, bar select+click fires zero env fetches, no geolocation control / navigator.geolocation untouched, no bar without a key). The SearchDestinations-available branch (building outline/entrances) is only verifiable on a live *.wecare.digital origin and is documented in the test file as such.
